ON THE 3 rd OF SEPTEMBER, 2025  WRIT PETITION No. 31026 of 2025  ASHOK  Versus  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND OTHERS  Appearance:
 Shri Sidharth Chhajed, learned counsel for the petiti  Shri Bhuwan Gautam, learned Government Advocate for t  respondents / State on advance copy.

The petitioner has filed the present petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking direction to the respondents to pay compensation for the additional land acquired for construction of the road.

02. The acquisition proceedings under the provision of National Highways Act, 1956 were drawn, in which land admeasuring 0.020 hectare of Survey No.850/1 belonging to the petitioner was acquired for which the compensation was paid vide award dated 01.10.2020.

03. The petitioner submitted a representation to the Tehsildar, Dewas in the year 2024 stating that the land bearing Survey No.850/1/1 admeasuring 0.190 hectare belongs to him and certain part of the land has NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:24721 2 WP-31026-2025 been acquired by the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) illegally without acquisition and payment of compensation.
04. The Tehsildar directed the Revenue Inspector to conduct a demarcation.
The demarcation was carried out in presence of petitioner and local villagers.
As per the Panchnama Report, 0.17 hectare land was found to be used for construction of Dewas - Ujjain Highway.

1 report submitted by the Revenue Inspector to Tehsildar is filed as Annexure-P/4.
05.
Admittedly, while drawing this Panchnama, NHAI officials were not called, therefore, this Panchnama and report are not binding on the NHAI.
Hence, on the basis of this report, no such direction can be given.
06. Let the petitioner apply afresh for demarcation of the land bearing Survey No.850/1/1.

The proceedings be drawn after issuing notice to the NHAI and after issuing notice to the NHAI and if the demarcation report comes in favour of the petitioner, then the petitioner shall be at liberty to avail the remedy available under the law.
07. Writ Petition stands dismissed to the extent indicated above.

(VIVEK RUSIA) (BINOD KUMA  JUDGE JUD  Ravi Ashok vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 3 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167895461/
